name: GD FPS Core
description: Extreme render profile and frame-pacing monitor for Geometry Dash 2.2081.

disable-object-glow.name: Disable level object glows
disable-object-glow.description: Hides the separate glow sprite attached to level objects. Visual-only; may reduce overdraw and draw work.

disable-object-particles.name: Hide level object particles
disable-object-particles.description: Hides particle emitters attached to GameObjects after activation. Particle simulation may still run; this primarily reduces rendering work.

disable-player-particles.name: Hide player visual particles
disable-player-particles.description: Hides ground, landing, dash, click, robot, UFO and swing particles. Player physics and inputs are unchanged. The Wave Trail and streaks are preserved.

disable-player-glow.name: Disable player icon and vehicle glow
disable-player-glow.description: Hides the player icon and vehicle glow sprites. Visual-only.

frame-monitor.name: Enable frame-pacing monitor
frame-monitor.description: Logs frame-call intervals and CPU drawScene duration every 120 samples. This is not a GPU timer or a guarantee of displayed FPS.
